registrations.render_scope: PASS_CURRENT_480_CPU_CUDA_204_CHECKPOINTS_EACH_AND_96_ONLINE_224_FRAMES_EACH
remaining_limits: Exact replay requires the certified source/runtime math profile; cross-BLAS-profile bitwise portability is not established.
Physical history capacity follows the source max_steps + 2 (1,202 actions at the registered 30-second/40-Hz defaults); ordinary stepping does not replay history.
Restoration reconstructs authoritative CPU engines and costs O(history); numeric State includes the source goal-image cache.
Dynamics remain DELEGATED_CPU. CUDA State storage and GPU rendering do not imply GPU physics.
Rendering is accepted only for the recorded reached-state/configuration corpus, with unchanged frozen visual criteria and per-frame normalized MSE <= 0.001.
No universal online speedup or complete source-paired throughput table is claimed. B16/full GPU replay-cost tables remain unfinished; available B1 and prototype timing scopes are recorded separately.
